title: Konsilio Configuration
description: Configuration file for the Konsilio Council of Experts MCP server

$schema.description: Path to this JSON schema file for IDE validation

items.description: Persona ID (e.g., security, performance, ux-dx, devops, or custom personas)

enabled.description: Expert personas to include in council consultations. Must have at least 2. Built-in personas: security, performance, ux-dx, devops, typescript, graph-dba, node-fullstack, dev-tooling, distributed-systems, test-architect

constitution.description: Path to optional constitution file with custom workflow rules

models.description: Default model configuration for all personas

experts.description: Default model for expert personas. Override per-persona with personaModels.

lead.description: Model for consolidation phases (extraction, critique, decision, synthesis)

formatter.description: Model used to format prose into structured JSON

personaModels.description: Per-persona model defaults. Maps personaId to model ID. Overrides models.experts for specific personas.

additionalProperties.description: OpenRouter model ID for this persona

expertMs.description: Timeout for expert analysis in milliseconds

leadMs.description: Timeout for consolidation phases in milliseconds

formatterMs.description: Timeout for formatting prose in milliseconds

maxDraftPlanLength.description: Maximum length of draft plan input in characters

maxHistorySessions.description: Maximum number of session history entries to retain

databasePath.description: Path to SQLite database file for session storage

cacheTtlSeconds.description: Cache time-to-live in seconds for persona data
